title: Chained Souls: Girmitiya
desc: I used maps, archive and motion to tell a history of indentured labour.
lead: I created motion sequences for Prachyam’s Chained Souls: Girmitiya, using maps, archival material and typography.
body: For Chained Souls: Girmitiya, I developed the visual direction and motion treatment for the sequences shown here. The work moves between scenes of workers, a map connecting India and Mauritius, historical material and typography.
detail: I brought together geographic movement, archival documents and scenes of working life through composition, typography and animation.
contribution: Led creative direction and visual design for the selected sequences.
Developed the composition, typography and motion treatment across maps, historical material and human scenes.
summary: I created motion sequences for Prachyam’s Chained Souls: Girmitiya, using maps, archival material and typography.
